name: BG3 Modded
description: Baldur's Gate 3 mod snapshot with modsettings and Script Extender

notes.title: Close Baldur's Gate 3 before installing
notes.body: The pack writes mods and modsettings into the game's data folder: the Windows app data folder or the Proton prefix. Close the game and its launcher first.

notes.title: Saves
notes.body: Saves are not part of the pack and are not synced. Adding or removing mods can affect existing saves.

notes.title: Native Linux needs BG3LE
notes.body: On the native Linux build, install BG3LE (https://www.nexusmods.com/baldursgate3/mods/25431) with its install.py before this pack. BG3LE provides the Script Extender API natively; the pack installs the same mods and modsettings. Launch the game from Steam so BG3LE's launch wrapper runs.

preconditions.title: Game data location is ready
preconditions.hint: Launch the vanilla game once from Steam.

preconditions.title: BG3LE is installed
preconditions.hint: Install BG3LE (Nexus mod 25431) with its install.py before installing this pack. https://www.nexusmods.com/baldursgate3/mods/25431
